item.title: AI Mania Is Eviscerating Global Decision-Making
item.description:
📝 Executives that tell the press that their company has gone insane will quickly find themselves removed from their positions. Every single one – we have seen 0% success in a year and a half, not only amongst projects we have been asked to participate in2, but even within projects that we have observed in passing while doing totally unrelated work. Employees don’t use internal chatbots because companies tend to have low-quality documentation and an LLM is not psychic – it can only know things that have been written down and made accessible.
🔗 Read more: https://ludic.mataroa.blog/blog/ai-mania-is-eviscerating-global-decision-making/#fnref:3
